ns2:section.sectionText: For up-to-date information about statistics course registration, please see our registration update pages: go.illinois.edu/StatisticsRegistration Registration for STAT 593 requires instructor approval. To seek instructor approval, see here: http://go.illinois.edu/stat593 Registration for STAT 593 without instructor approval will result in a failing grade. This section is for 1 TO 8 CREDIT HOURS. Grading: Standard Letter.
